title: Name Brands Are Stealing $2,100/Year From You
hook: The generic sitting next to it was made in the same factory — and people spend $2,100 more every year for the label alone.
angle: Most people know about generic medications but don't realize 80% of grocery store-brand products are manufactured by the same companies as name brands — making the brand premium a pure psychological tax.
audience: Anyone who buys groceries and has never questioned why they reach for the name brand over the identical product next to it
key_numbers: $2,100/year average premium paid for name brands over store brands
80% of store-brand products made by name-brand manufacturers
$237,000 if that difference is invested over 30 years at 8%
$13 billion spent on CPG advertising annually
